_comment: SBC for the h_m01_size menu-size variant (RQ6; plan 8.6).
extra_params_after_gamma must mirror the pars_/ranks_ ORDER in
models/h_m01_size_sbc.stan exactly: gamma0, gamma[1..P], gamma_size,
sigma_cell, alpha_cell[1..J], delta[1..K-1]. A mismatch mislabels every
rank histogram without erroring.
This is SBC, not the null-calibration check: here gamma_size is drawn from
its prior and must show uniform ranks. The null check (gamma_size fixed at
zero) is a separate run via h_m01_size_sim with gamma_size_sd = 0.
iter_warmup and adapt_delta are set explicitly rather than inherited. The
class default would give 500 warmup at CmdStan's default adapt_delta, and a
pass at those settings produced max R_hat 1.10 with divergences for this
model. SBC is especially exposed to that: poor adaptation distorts the ranks
directly, and with a single chain there is no R_hat available to catch it.
M_per_cell is 30 here against 60 in the recovery config, and deliberately so.
SBC validates CALIBRATION, which holds at any N; recovery validates PRECISION,
which wants a realistic N. Measured cost is linear in M_total (180s per sim at
M_total=180, 377s at 360), so the smaller design halves a 100-sim run from
~10.5 h to ~5 h without weakening what the check establishes.
Do not shrink it much further: at M_total=72 a sim took LONGER (284s) than at
180, because with very little data the posterior is nearly prior-dominated and
the beta ridge is unconstrained. Smaller is not reliably cheaper.
max_treedepth 12 is kept only as a safety cap. Measured max treedepth is 7
with 0% saturation and zero divergences, so it costs nothing over the default.
